query: 一股一票制 一股一票制 衡量企业资本结构中每份普通股是否拥有平等的投票权。重点考察是否存在同股不同权、多重投票权架构（Dual-class Structure）或限制特定股东表决权的协议。 一致性评估 (权重 100%，取值：0, 1, 2) • 2分（高分/卓越）：企业严格执行“一股一票”原则；公司章程明确规定所有普通股具有同等的表决权、收益权和剩余财产分配权；不存在任何差异化投票权安排。 • 1分（中分/合格）：基本遵循一股一票，但存在少量、特定情形下的例外（如：因库存股、员工持股计划暂无投票权，或政府在特定行业持有的“黄金股”且仅限重大安全事项行权）。 • 0分（低分/不合格）：多重投票权架构普遍存在（如 A/B 股，B 股拥有 10 倍于 A 股的投票权）；或通过金字塔结构、交叉持股实质性导致控制权与所有权严重偏离。 一股一票 同股同权 同等表决权 同等收益权 同等剩余财产分配权 双重股权 不同投票权架构 加权投票权 黄金股 金字塔持股 同股不同权 WVR one share one vote equal voting rights equal profit distribution rights equal rights to residual assets pari passu dual-class shares multiple voting rights weighted voting rights WVR golden share pyramid structure 公司章程是否明确所有普通股每股一票，并具有同等收益权和剩余财产分配权？ 是否存在双重股权、多重投票权或差异化表决安排？ 是否存在黄金股、库存股或ESOP等例外？ 控制权与所有权是否通过金字塔或交叉持股发生偏离？ 结论依据哪些章程、股本结构或上市文件？
instruction: Assess whether the passage provides concrete evidence for the ESG indicator '一股一票制'. Prefer explicit, auditable disclosure that answers: 公司章程是否明确所有普通股每股一票，并具有同等收益权和剩余财产分配权？ 是否存在双重股权、多重投票权或差异化表决安排？ 是否存在黄金股、库存股或ESOP等例外？ 控制权与所有权是否通过金字塔或交叉持股发生偏离？ 结论依据哪些章程、股本结构或上市文件？ Exclude or down-rank: 排除：仅有独立董事比例；仅有股东大会议事规则；仅有股息政策；仅讨论员工股权激励而无投票权结构；区分：一股一票制判断是否存在平等投票权；投票权差异进一步评估差异化架构的复杂程度、不公平性与日落条款等抵消保护。无差异时可在两指标都体现，但侧重点不同。 Preserve relevant tables, notes, units, limitations, policies, targets, methods and coverage details.

results.text: The Group strives to create an equal and inclusive working environment free of discrimination or harassment. We have zero tolerance for any form of discrimination on the grounds of age, gender, race or religion. We also prohibit all unfair and discriminating employment practices. [Content]
The Group strives to create an equal and inclusive working environment free of discrimination or harassment. We have zero tolerance for any form of discrimination on the grounds of age, gender, race or religion. We also prohibit all unfair and discriminating employment practices. In order to maintain a diversified workplace, a Board Diversity Policy is in place to assess the Board composition under diversified perspectives including gender, age, cultural and educational background and professional experience. As an equal opportunity employer, we continue to provide equal opportunity in all aspects to all employees and ensure that labour practices followed are fair and ethical, and respect the fundamental human rights of all employees.

results.text: A total of 26 potential topics were marked in the assessment covering environmental, social and operational aspects. A questionnaire was administered online to internal stakeholders to collect their opinions on these material topics. Based on opinions received, the 26 identified issues were prioritised into four levels. The most pertinent topics (Level I) of the Group included anti-corruption, precautionary measures of child/forced labour, operating compliance and protection of intellectual property rights. The final results were reviewed and validated by the management of the Group.

[Content]
A total of 26 potential topics were marked in the assessment covering environmental, social and operational aspects. A questionnaire was administered online to internal stakeholders to collect their opinions on these material topics. Based on opinions received, the 26 identified issues were prioritised into four levels. The most pertinent topics (Level I) of the Group included anti-corruption, precautionary measures of child/forced labour, operating compliance and protection of intellectual property rights. The final results were reviewed and validated by the management of the Group.

results.text: Greenhouse gas ('GHG') emissions from our business operations include direct emissions from fuel consumption (Scope 1), indirect emissions from the use of electricity (Scope 2) and other indirect emissions from business travel by air, paper disposal at landfills, freshwater processing and sewage treatment (Scope 3). During the year, the Group's total GHG emissions were 301.1 tonnes of carbon dioxide equivalent (tCO 2 e), with an emission intensity of 0.08 tCO 2 e per square meter of floor area. The GHG emissions were mainly contributed by emissions from the use of electricity, which constituted around 62% of total GHG emissions.

results.text: The Group continues to follow a green office policy and has taken a range of measures for conserving energy, water and paper consumed in its operations to ensure efficient management and use of resources.
